Details.title: Details
Details.description: The full part-reorder payload as a JSON string, formatted EXACTLY like this: {"title":"Reorder part","part":{"name":"Industrial I/O Controller","sku":"IOC-4820-DIN","category":"controller","imageUrl":"/resource/asaMfgIoController","unitPrice":486,"currency":"USD","leadTime":"Ships in 3–5 business days","inStock":142,"minOrder":1,"incrementStep":1},"quantity":2,"submitText":"Reorder"} This card shows ONE part only. Rules: - 'title' (string, optional): heading. Defaults to 'Reorder part'. - 'part' (object, REQUIRED): 'name' (string, REQUIRED). Optional: 'sku' (string, shown monospace); 'category' (string); 'imageUrl' (string, same-origin https URL or '/resource/<Name>'; use '/resource/asaMfgIoController' for the sample part); 'unitPrice' (number; enables the live subtotal); 'currency' (ISO code, default USD); 'leadTime' (string, e.g. 'Ships in 3–5 business days'); 'inStock' (number; renders a stock bar — ≤10 shows amber 'low', ≤0 shows red 'Out of stock' and caps the quantity); 'minOrder' (number, minimum + starting quantity, default 1); 'incrementStep' (number, +/- step size, default 1). - 'quantity' (number, optional): initial quantity; clamped to at least 'minOrder' and at most 'inStock' when known. The customer adjusts it with the stepper before submitting. - 'submitText' (string, optional): button label prefix; defaults to 'Reorder'. The button also shows the live subtotal (or unit count). - 'submitValue' (string, optional): a base message; the card appends the chosen quantity + SKU when sending back. Use these EXACT field names — they are the single contract the card reads.
